description: ENA - Estadística de Aforo Vehicular por Corredor is a series of datasets listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa Nacional de Autopista. Este conjunto de datos muestra la información referente a la Estadística de Aforo Vehicular por Corredor (Este, Norte y Sur) de Empresa Nacional de Autopista, S.A. en formato abierto. Coverage: Panamá. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa Nacional de Autopista. Its tags are aforo, conteo, corredor, trafico, vehicular. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2019-03-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
